verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair question for a seller-management platform like Square, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. The official MCP server lets external agents connect to Square, which is a different capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
